Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views

Class RegionDef.Field

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.RegionDef.Field
Enclosing class:
RegionDef
public static class RegionDef.Field extends Object
One entry in the field catalog: a label, an optional named renderer and its meta, an optional href template, a paint format, a grid span, and per-field action-bar ids.

Card and tab regions only — see RegionDef.fields.

Since:
10.0.0

  • Field Details

    • data

      public String data
      The key into ctx.data's values map. Unique across the enclosing RegionDef.

    • label

      public String label
      The label shown above the value. null falls back to data at paint time.

    • render

      public String render
      Optional named renderer id, resolved against the same NS._renderers registry as today.

    • renderMeta

      public Map<String,Object> renderMeta
      Optional metadata handed to render's renderer function.

    • href

      public String href
      Optional {property} URL template consumed by the linked renderer (and any renderer that reads it). Independent of render.

    • format

      public FieldFormat format
      How the value is painted. null means FieldFormat.TEXT.

    • span

      public FieldSpan span
      How many of the grid's columns this field occupies. null means FieldSpan.ONE.

    • actions

      public List<String> actions
      Action ids painted beside this field's value. Ids only — the bar itself is rendered by the client helper, not by this bean.

    • visibleWhen

      public List<VisibilityRule> visibleWhen
      The rules that must all match for this one detail field to render. null or empty means always visible. See RowAction.visibleWhen for the shared semantics.
